nodes.description: Mapping of account balances stored in contract reddit, credited/debited without overflow checks.
Nested allowance mapping used by transferFrom and approve functions.
Public total supply of UPVOTE tokens, set once in the constructor.
ERC20 token name set in the UPVOTE constructor.
Token decimals (18) set in the UPVOTE constructor.
Token symbol 'UPV' set in the UPVOTE constructor.
Hard-coded public version string 'H1.0'.
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to, mutating balances with unchecked += and -=.
Transfers tokens on behalf of _from using the allowed mapping, with unchecked arithmetic on balances and allowance.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Fallback function that unconditionally throws, rejecting all plain ether transfers.
Constructor that mints the entire supply to msg.sender and sets token metadata.
Sets allowance and emits Approval but performs no external call despite its name.
Caller-controlled address used as the balance/allowance key and constructor beneficiary.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value inside transfer; unchecked subtraction can underflow.
balances[_to] += _value inside transfer; unchecked addition can overflow.
balances[_to] += _value inside transferFrom; unchecked addition can overflow.
balances[_from] -= _value inside transferFrom; unchecked subtraction can underflow.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside transferFrom; unchecked allowance underflow.
